title: New crate: yencoding-multi (yEnc multi-part reassembly)
description:
Reassembles multi-part yEnc Usenet articles into complete files.

Depends on: yencoding (for DecodedPart and encode_part)
Does NOT depend on: mime-tree, NZB crates, NNTP crates
No filesystem I/O -- caller provides decoded parts, crate produces reassembled Vec<u8>

The problem this solves: a multi-part yEnc post is split across N Usenet articles. Each article is independently yEnc-decoded to produce a DecodedPart with begin=/end= byte offsets into the complete file. This crate takes a collection of DecodedParts, verifies they cover the complete byte range without gaps, checks the whole-file CRC32, and returns the reassembled bytes.

Public API shape:
  pub struct Assembler { ... }  -- collects parts
  impl Assembler {
      pub fn new(total_size: u64) -> Self
      pub fn add_part(&mut self, part: DecodedPart) -> Result<(), AssemblyError>
      pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool
      pub fn missing_ranges(&self) -> Vec<Range<u64>>  -- 0-based byte ranges not yet received
      pub fn finish(self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AssemblyError>  -- verifies CRC32, returns file bytes
  }

  pub enum AssemblyError {
      OverlappingPart { existing: Range<u64>, new: Range<u64> }
      OutOfRange { begin: u64, end: u64, total_size: u64 }
      CrcMismatch { expected: u32, actual: u32 }  -- whole-file CRC32 on finish()
      Incomplete { missing: Vec<Range<u64>> }  -- finish() called before is_complete()
  }

Out of scope: NZB parsing, NNTP transport, fetching articles, filename-from-subject heuristics.

Status: PLANNED. Do not start until yencoding (MIME-inm) is complete.
